claims.text: Haleth tried to defend Edoras from the Dunlendings who had invaded in , but he was killed at the doors of Meduseld, the last of its defenders. Wulf son of Freca usurped the throne while Helm and Háma fled to Helm's Deep.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The House of Eorl"
